title: Figure 11: Schematic of EV (pulse discharge source) device
description: Line schematic of an electrum validum (EV) generating device showing a -V supply and capacitor C connected via a switch to a cathode, with a dashed "PATH" over a "DIELECTRIC" layer leading to an "IMPACT SITE" on a "GROUND PLANE". Caption: "Figure 11. Schematic of EV (Pulse Discharge Source) Device (Reference 47)." Text above describes Bostick and Shoulders' micro-arc discharge devices.
